info.description:
The JSON interface to a Hyperuplink board. It serves the
categories, forums, topics and replies the board shows in the
browser, the account of the caller and the administration, under
the prefix /api/v1 on a port of its own.

A request without a key is a guest and reads what the board's
default permission grants to guests, as long as the administrator
allows guest access to the API. A request with a key acts as the
user the key belongs to. Keys are obtained by signing in through
POST /session with username and password, or on the board under
Account -> API, and they are sent as a bearer token in the
Authorization header. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a
stable machine code in the "code" member.
info.title: Hyperuplink API

get.description:
The board's name, the API version, the build, whether requests
without a key are served, and the paths of the main collections.
This is the one document a client may always read.

The signed-in user's own record, with the email address, the
timezone, the groups and the notification preference.

patch.description:
Changes the fields that are present: the language, one of de, en,
es, fr, it and ro, the timezone, the signature, which is Markdown,
and whether replies to the user's topics are announced by message.
Fields that are left out stay as they are.

get.description:
Every API key of the signed-in user, newest first, without the
secrets, which the board doesn't keep.

post.description:
Creates a named API key for the signed-in user and returns its
secret once, in token.

delete.description:
Deletes one of the signed-in user's keys. A key of another user is
reported as not found.

put.description:
The current password has to be sent with the new one and its
repetition, and an account with two-factor authentication adds
the current code. Keys stay valid.

parameters.description: The current and the new password
parameters.name: request

post.description:
Replaces the picture with the image sent as the multipart field
"picture", converted to the board's picture format. Rejected when
the board has pictures disabled.

get.description:
Whether two-factor authentication is on. While it is off, a fresh
enrollment comes along, with the otpauth URL to scan, its secret
and a QR code as a data URI; the client sends the URL back with a
code to turn it on.

post.description:
Turns two-factor authentication on with the otpauth URL of an
enrollment and a code generated from it, which proves that the
authenticator holds the secret.

parameters.description: The otpauth URL and a current code
parameters.name: request

delete.description:
Turns two-factor authentication off; the current password confirms
the request.

Location.description: The path of the new category

delete.description: The delete is soft and propagates to everything below.

Location.description: The path of the new forum

delete.description: The delete is soft and propagates to everything below.

put.summary: Update the general settings, including whether guests may use the API

get.description:
Each issue names something the board has found wrong with its own
configuration; an empty list is the healthy answer.
The administrators' visits and settings changes, newest first.

get.summary: Show the groups and their permissions

post.description:
Without group_id and category_id this sets the board's default
level; with category_id alone it sets that category's default for
everyone, where the level "inherit" removes it again; with both it
grants the group that level in the category.

Location.description: The path of the new group

post.summary: Revoke a group's permission in a category, or a category's default

parameters.description: The category, and the group unless the category's default is meant
parameters.name: request

get.description: Every user including the banned and the deleted ones, newest first.

delete.description: The delete is soft; the user's posts stay.

post.summary: Confirm a user's address by hand

put.description:
Replaces the groups the user belongs to with member_of; ids that
name no group are dropped.

post.description:
Stores one or more files sent as the multipart field "attachments"
and returns them with their ids, which a topic or a reply then names
in attachment_ids. Uploads are rejected when the board has
attachments disabled.

get.description:
The file is streamed back under the name it was uploaded with. An
attachment of a post the viewer may not read is reported as not
found.

The categories the viewer may read, each with its forums, and the
five most recently active topics among them.
Every category the viewer may read, with its forums.

One category with its forums, addressed by UUID or slug. A category
the viewer may not read is reported as not found.

Every forum the viewer may read, ordered by category and position,
each with the viewer's permissions in it, which is how a client
finds out where it may post.

One forum, addressed by UUID or slug. A forum the viewer may not
read is reported as not found.

One page of the forum's topics, pinned ones first, in the requested
order: active (the default, newest activity first), new (newest
topic first) or replies (most replies first).

One of the texts the administrator can enable: about, contact,
privacy or terms. A page that is disabled is reported as not found.

One reply, addressed by UUID or short id, with the topic it belongs
to, its position among the topic's replies and the page of the
reply collection it is on at the board's posts-per-page setting.

parameters.description: The reply UUID or short id
parameters.name: reply

get.description:
Full-text search over what the viewer may read. The "in" parameter
narrows the match to topic titles, topic bodies and replies in any
combination; without it all three are searched.

parameters.description: Only match posts by this username
parameters.name: author

parameters.description: A comma-separated subset of title, body and replies
parameters.name: in

get.description:
Who the request acts as: a guest when no key was sent, otherwise
the key's user with the key itself, and in both cases the
permission level the viewer has by default and per category.

post.description:
Exchanges a username and a password for an API key. An account
with two-factor authentication has to send the current code in
otp_code; without it the problem code is err_otp_required, so a
client can ask for the code in a second step. The key is named
after name, or after the time of the sign-in, and its secret is
returned once, in token. Accounts that signed up through an
OAuth provider have no password and obtain their keys on the
board instead.

parameters.description: The credentials and an optional key name
parameters.name: request

delete.description:
Revokes the key the request was made with. The next request with
that key is rejected.

get.description:
One page of topics from every forum the viewer may read, pinned
ones first, in the requested order: active (the default, newest
activity first), new (newest topic first) or replies (most replies
first).

post.description:
Creates a topic in the forum named by forum_id, as a regular topic
or as a poll with poll_options and an optional poll_ends_at in the
author's timezone. Attachments are uploaded beforehand and named in
attachment_ids. The viewer needs write permission in the forum's
category.

Location.description: The path of the new topic

get.description:
One topic with its poll, addressed by UUID or short id, without its
replies, which are a collection of their own. A signed-in viewer
gets the read marker and the vote state as well. A topic the viewer
may not read is reported as not found.

parameters.description: The topic UUID or short id
parameters.name: topic

get.description:
One page of the topic's replies, oldest first. A reply that answers
another reply names it in parent_id.

parameters.description: The topic UUID or short id
parameters.name: topic

post.description:
Adds a reply to the topic, or to one of its replies when parent_id
names it. Attachments are uploaded beforehand and named in
attachment_ids. The topic's author and earlier repliers are
notified. The viewer needs write permission in the topic's
category.

parameters.description: The topic UUID or short id
parameters.name: topic

Location.description: The path of the new reply

post.description:
Casts the viewer's vote for the option at index selection. A vote
is final, so a second one is a conflict, and a poll that has ended
takes no more votes. The viewer needs write permission in the
topic's category.

parameters.description: The topic UUID or short id
parameters.name: topic

get.description:
The public profile of a user with the groups they belong to and
their ten newest topics and replies the viewer may read.
